latest_publication.original_editorial_asset: A four-part interruption-cost framework covering task time, setup time, restart time and delay cost, plus a five-day interruption audit and worked annual capacity example.
latest_publication.first_hand_contribution_or_limits: Uses Henry Oliver's operator, consulting, data and process-design perspective. It does not claim a scientific context-switching constant or invent client results.
